description: This file defines an internal class 'EventMonitor' that tracks input events and selections in an Android input method service, providing debugging messages via a callback.

classes.name: EventMonitor
classes.description: A class that monitors input events such as start, finish, and selection updates, maintaining internal state and invoking a callback with debug messages.

methods.name: onStartInput
methods.description: Handles the start of input, updating state and editor info.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Handles the finishing of input, resetting relevant state.

methods.name: onUpdateSelection
methods.description: Updates selection and composition information, then updates debug message.

methods.name: updateMessage
methods.description: Builds a debug message string representing current state and calls callback.

methods.name: cloneEditorInfo
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an EditorInfo object via Parcel marshalling.
